title: Two Heavenly Flames
summary: Xiao Yan survives the Fallen Heart Flame's refining: his meridians are tougher, his Dou Crystal is gone, and Dou Qi now flows from his whole body, enough to form Dou Qi Wings. His storage ring has burned away, and he believes the pills and herbs inside kept him alive. He finds the flame's core and, using the Flame Mantra, merges the Fallen Heart Flame with his Green Lotus Core Flame, then has to fight off the evil fire the merge sets off. In the capital, Hai Bodong and Ya Fei note that the Misty Cloud Sect has turned shady since Yun Shan removed Yun Yun as leader, and in the Black-Corner Region Xiao Li fights the Black Alliance to avenge his brother. Underground, Xiao Yan talks Medusa into a truce so they can break out together. At the academy, Xiao Yu still hopes he is alive, and when the elders reopen the Blazing Qi Refining Tower, the Fallen Heart Flame bursts out and Xiao Yan comes out with it, free.
